import json
def import_rows(source, output, checkpoint):
    offset = int(checkpoint.read_text()) if checkpoint.exists() else 0
    rows = source.read_text().splitlines()

        for i, row in enumerate(rows[offset:], start=offset):

def start_registry(settings_service, ready):
    settings = settings_service.wait_until_ready()
    bind_port(settings.registry_port)
    ready.set()

def start_settings(registry, ready):
    registry.wait_until_ready()
    publish_settings()
    ready.set()

The registry readiness signal requires settings readiness. Settings readiness requires registry readiness. Each starts concurrently in a separate service process. A service is ready only after its published interface can serve callers.

teams.rationale: A cross-service bootstrap dependency cycle and readiness invariants are explicit. Resource/startup ownership and premise derivation are relevant additions.
